title: How Buddy Petit learned; blues players Chris Kelly and Louis Armstrong
summary: Glass says Buddy Petit practised alone at Robinson and St. Anthony, and names Chris Kelly and Armstrong as good blues players.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: What do you think Buddy got his style of playing? Buddy Petit I'm talking about.

Buddy Petit got his, learned right there on St. Anthony and Robinson. From whom? I didn't know who he learned it from. I know he used to sit down there all day, half of the night, blowing right there, Robinson and St. Anthony, the old corner house. I know when Buddy Petit was learning. I just thought. His first wife was named Lizzy.
Buddy Petit. I thought maybe he had somebody there who might have given him a few little tips on how to make all that stuff.
No, I used to just see him there by himself. He'd be blowing there. Working out himself?
He's a blues player too. Chris Keller was a blues player too. Who else played good blues?
Well, Louis Armstrong used to be good too. He was a good blues player. Do you really think he's good?
Oh yeah. I know he's good. I know he's good. I know he's good. Louis come from the home. From Jones home. Many of them did.
Yeah. Jones is throwing a lot of good trumpet players out there now.
